**Project Summary: ArduPilot SITL Manager**\\\\n\\\\n### **1. Project Purpose**\\\\nWeb-based management tool for ArduPilot SITL (Software In The Loop) simulators running in Docker containers. Enables:\\\\n- Managing Docker containers running ArduPilot SITL\\\\n- Creating and managing multiple simulated drones\\\\n- Real-time telemetry monitoring\\\\n- Flight control (ARM, DISARM, mode changes, GOTO commands)\\\\n- Interactive map visualization\\\\n- Scenario saving/loading\\\\n- Parameter management\\\\n\\\\n### **2. Tech Stack**\\\\n\\\\n**Backend:**\\\\n- Python 3 with Flask (web framework)\\\\n- Flask-SocketIO (WebSocket support)\\\\n- Docker SDK (container management)\\\\n- Subprocess (process management)\\\\n\\\\n**Frontend:**\\\\n- HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript (vanilla)\\\\n- Leaflet.js (mapping)\\\\n- Socket.IO client (real-time communication)\\\\n- Split.js (resizable panels)\\\\n\\\\n**Dependencies (&#96;requirements.txt&#96;):**\\\\n- &#96;flask==3.1.0&#96;\\\\n- &#96;flask-socketio==5.5.1&#96;\\\\n- &#96;docker==7.1.0&#96;\\\\n\\\\n**Build/Packaging:**\\\\n- PyInstaller spec file (&#96;ArduPilotSITLManager.spec&#96;) for creating standalone executables\\\\n\\\\n### **3. Root Directory Structure**\\\\n\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\nd:\\\\\\\\ardupilot\\\\\\\\\\\\n├── app.py                          # Main Flask application (1027 lines)\\\\n├── requirements.txt                # Python dependencies\\\\n├── ArduPilotSITLManager.spec      # PyInstaller configuration\\\\n├── saved_locations.json           # Saved location data\\\\n├── scenarios.json                  # Saved drone scenarios\\\\n├── templates/\\\\n│   ├── index.html                  # Main dashboard page\\\\n│   └── map.html                    # Flight control map page\\\\n├── static/\\\\n│   ├── app.js                      # Main dashboard JavaScript (1430 lines)\\\\n│   ├── map.js                      # Map page JavaScript (632 lines)\\\\n│   ├── style.css                   # Dashboard styles (1758 lines)\\\\n│   ├── map.css                     # Map page styles (798 lines)\\\\n│   ├── sim_params.js               # Simulation parameter computation engine\\\\n│   └── full_params.js              # Full parameter editor engine\\\\n└── .specstory/                     # Project history/documentation\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\n\\\\n### **4. Main Entry Points**\\\\n\\\\n**Primary entry point:** &#96;app.py&#96;\\\\n- Flask app runs on &#96;http://0.0.0.0:5000&#96;\\\\n- Main routes:\\\\n  - &#96;/&#96; - Dashboard (&#96;index.html&#96;)\\\\n  - &#96;/map&#96; - Flight control map (&#96;map.html&#96;)\\\\n  - &#96;/api/*&#96; - REST API endpoints\\\\n  - WebSocket events via SocketIO\\\\n\\\\n**Key functions in &#96;app.py&#96;:**\\\\n- &#96;_start_drone_process()&#96; - Launches ArduPilot SITL instances\\\\n- &#96;stream_drone_output()&#96; - Parses MAVLink telemetry\\\\n- &#96;check_container_status()&#96; - Monitors Docker container\\\\n- &#96;_parse_line_telemetry()&#96; - Parses MAVProxy output\\\\n\\\\n### **5. Architecture Overview**\\\\n\\\\n**Backend architecture:**\\\\n- Flask app with SocketIO for real-time communication\\\\n- Global state: &#96;container_state&#96;, &#96;drones&#96; dictionary\\\\n- Threading: separate threads for output streaming and background monitoring\\\\n- Docker integration: uses &#96;docker exec&#96; to run &#96;sim_vehicle.py&#96; inside containers\\\\n- MAVLink parsing: regex-based parsing of MAVProxy terminal output\\\\n\\\\n**Frontend architecture:**\\\\n- Two-page application:\\\\n  1. Dashboard (&#96;index.html&#96;): Container/drone management, terminal, controls\\\\n  2. Map page (&#96;map.html&#96;): Real-time flight visualization, waypoint planning\\\\n- Real-time updates via WebSocket\\\\n- Split-panel layout (resizable)\\\\n- State management: client-side state in JavaScript objects\\\\n\\\\n**Key features:**\\\\n1. Docker container management: start/stop, status monitoring, port mapping\\\\n2. Multi-drone support: multiple SITL instances with unique instance IDs\\\\n3. Telemetry parsing: GPS, attitude, battery, flight mode, etc.\\\\n4. Interactive maps: Leaflet.js with real-time position updates\\\\n5. Scenario system: save/load/duplicate/rename drone configurations\\\\n6. Location management: save/load favorite locations\\\\n7. Parameter management: simulation parameters and full parameter editor\\\\n8. Command interface: MAVProxy command forwarding\\\\n\\\\n**Data flow:**\\\\n1. User starts container → Flask starts Docker container\\\\n2. User creates drone → Flask executes &#96;sim_vehicle.py&#96; in container\\\\n3. Process output → Threaded parser extracts MAVLink data\\\\n4. Telemetry → WebSocket emits to frontend\\\\n5. Frontend → Updates map markers, telemetry displays, control panels\\\\n\\\\n**File purposes:**\\\\n- &#96;app.py&#96;: Backend server, API, WebSocket handlers, telemetry parsing\\\\n- &#96;static/app.js&#96;: Dashboard UI logic, container/drone management\\\\n- &#96;static/map.js&#96;: Map visualization, waypoint planning, flight control\\\\n- &#96;static/sim_params.js&#96;: Simulation parameter computation (wind, GPS, barometer, etc.)\\\\n- &#96;static/full_params.js&#96;: Full ArduPilot parameter editor\\\\n- &#96;saved_locations.json&#96;: Persistent location storage\\\\n- &#96;scenarios.json&#96;: Persistent scenario storage\\\\n\\\\n**Communication protocol:**\\\\n- REST API: HTTP endpoints for CRUD operations\\\\n- WebSocket: Real-time telemetry, terminal output, status updates\\\\n- MAVLink: Parsed from MAVProxy output (not direct MAVLink connection)\\\\n\\\\n### **6. Notable Implementation Details**\\\\n\\\\n1. Telemetry parsing: Multiple regex patterns to extract data from MAVProxy text output\\\\n2. Motion interpolation: Smooth marker animation on map page using interpolation/extrapolation\\\\n3. Thread safety: Uses &#96;threading.Lock()&#96; for drone dictionary access\\\\n4. Process management: Handles subprocess lifecycle, stdin/stdout/stderr streaming\\\\n5. Cross-platform: Windows-specific process group handling (&#96;CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP&#96;)\\\\n\\\\n### **7. Project Status**\\\\n- Fully functional web application\\\\n- Turkish language interface\\\\n- Production-ready features (scenarios, locations, parameter management)\\\\n- PyInstaller spec suggests intent to package as standalone executable\\\\n\\\\nThis is a production-ready tool for managing ArduPilot SITL simulations through a web interface, with real-time monitoring, control, and visualization.\\\"}\"},\"status\":\"completed\",\"context\":{\"composers\":[],\"selectedCommits\":[],\"selectedPullRequests\":[],\"selectedImages\":[],\"folderSelections\":[],\"fileSelections\":[],\"selections\":[],\"terminalSelections\":[],\"selectedDocs\":[],\"externalLinks\":[],\"cursorRules\":[],\"cursorCommands\":[],\"gitPRDiffSelections\":[],\"subagentSelections\":[],\"browserSelections\":[],\"mentions\":{\"composers\":{},\"selectedCommits\":{},\"selectedPullRequests\":{},\"gitDiff\":[],\"gitDiffFromBranchToMain\":[],\"selectedImages\":{},\"folderSelections\":{},\"fileSelections\":{},\"terminalFiles\":{},\"selections\":{},\"terminalSelections\":{},\"selectedDocs\":{},\"externalLinks\":{},\"diffHistory\":[],\"cursorRules\":{},\"cursorCommands\":{},\"uiElementSelections\":[],\"consoleLogs\":[],\"ideEditorsState\":[],\"gitPRDiffSelections\":{},\"subagentSelections\":{},\"browserSelections\":{}}},\"generatingBubbleIds\":[],\"isReadingLongFile\":false,\"codeBlockData\":{},\"originalFileStates\":{},\"newlyCreatedFiles\":[],\"newlyCreatedFolders\":[],\"createdAt\":1771773557119,\"hasChangedContext\":false,\"activeTabsShouldBeReactive\":true,\"capabilities\":[{\"type\":30,\"data\":{}},{\"type\":15,\"data\":{\"bubbleDataMap\":\"{}\"}}],\"name\":\"Explore Frontend/UI Architecture Summary\\\\n\\\\n### 1. Technology Stack &amp; Frameworks\\\\n\\\\nNo modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte). Uses:\\\\n- Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+)\\\\n- HTML5\\\\n- CSS3 with CSS Custom Properties (CSS Variables)\\\\n- External libraries:\\\\n  - Leaflet.js (v1.9.4) for maps\\\\n  - Socket.IO (v4.7.5) for real-time communication\\\\n  - Split.js (v1.6.0) for resizable panels\\\\n\\\\n### 2. File Structure\\\\n\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\nd:\\\\\\\\ardupilot\\\\\\\\\\\\n├── templates/\\\\n│   ├── index.html          # Main dashboard page\\\\n│   └── map.html            # Flight control map page\\\\n└── static/\\\\n    ├── style.css           # Main dashboard styles (1758 lines)\\\\n    ├── map.css             # Map page styles (798 lines)\\\\n    ├── app.js              # Main application logic (1430 lines)\\\\n    ├── map.js              # Map page logic (632 lines)\\\\n    ├── sim_params.js       # Simulation parameters editor\\\\n    └── full_params.js      # Full parameter editor\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Styling Approach\\\\n\\\\nCSS custom properties (CSS variables) for theming:\\\\n\\\\n**Color Scheme** (Dark theme):\\\\n- Primary background: &#96;#0a0e17&#96;\\\\n- Secondary background: &#96;#111827&#96;\\\\n- Card background: &#96;rgba(26, 34, 54, 0.75)&#96;\\\\n- Accent colors:\\\\n  - Blue: &#96;#3b82f6&#96;\\\\n  - Green: &#96;#10b981&#96;\\\\n  - Red: &#96;#ef4444&#96;\\\\n  - Orange: &#96;#f59e0b&#96;\\\\n  - Purple: &#96;#8b5cf6&#96;\\\\n\\\\n**Typography**:\\\\n- Primary font: &#96;Inter&#96; (Google Fonts)\\\\n- Monospace: &#96;JetBrains Mono&#96; (Google Fonts)\\\\n- Map page uses &#96;Space Grotesk&#96;\\\\n\\\\n**Design patterns**:\\\\n- Glassmorphism (backdrop-filter blur)\\\\n- Gradient accents\\\\n- Smooth transitions (&#96;cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)&#96;)\\\\n- Box shadows for depth\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Layout Architecture\\\\n\\\\n**Main Dashboard (&#96;index.html&#96;)**:\\\\n- Header: fixed top bar with logo, title, status badge\\\\n- Sidebar: collapsible left panel (280px) with:\\\\n  - Docker container controls\\\\n  - Drone creation form\\\\n  - Scenarios management\\\\n- Main area: split view\\\\n  - Left: drone list table\\\\n  - Right: control panel + terminal (vertical split)\\\\n\\\\n**Map Page (&#96;map.html&#96;)**:\\\\n- Header: fixed top bar with controls\\\\n- Main: three-column layout\\\\n  - Left panel: waypoint controls (collapsible, 280px)\\\\n  - Center: Leaflet map (flexible)\\\\n  - Right panel: telemetry cards (collapsible, 300px)\\\\n\\\\n### 5. UI Components\\\\n\\\\n**Buttons**:\\\\n- Primary: gradient blue\\\\n- Success: green\\\\n- Danger: red\\\\n- Outline: transparent with border\\\\n- Size variants: &#96;btn-sm&#96;, &#96;btn-block&#96;\\\\n\\\\n**Forms**:\\\\n- Compact form groups\\\\n- Inputs with dark backgrounds\\\\n- Focus states with blue glow\\\\n- Status rows with grid layout\\\\n\\\\n**Cards &amp; Panels**:\\\\n- Glassmorphic cards with backdrop blur\\\\n- Collapsible sections with accordion behavior\\\\n- Panel headers with toggle icons\\\\n\\\\n**Modals**:\\\\n- Overlay with backdrop blur\\\\n- Map modals for location selection\\\\n- Responsive sizing\\\\n\\\\n**Toast Notifications**:\\\\n- Fixed position (top-right)\\\\n- Slide-in animation\\\\n- Types: success, error, info\\\\n\\\\n### 6. Responsive Design\\\\n\\\\nMedia queries:\\\\n\\\\n**Tablet/Mobile (max-width: 900px)**:\\\\n- Sidebar becomes fixed overlay (slides in from left)\\\\n- Hamburger menu button appears\\\\n- Split views stack vertically\\\\n- Modal width: 95vw\\\\n\\\\n**Small Mobile (max-width: 600px)**:\\\\n- Header title font size reduced\\\\n- Modal width: 98vw, height: 85vh\\\\n- Control grids become single column\\\\n\\\\n**Responsive features**:\\\\n- Viewport meta tag: &#96;width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0&#96;\\\\n- Flexible grid layouts\\\\n- Touch-friendly button sizes (min-height: 36px on mobile)\\\\n- Sidebar overlay for mobile navigation\\\\n\\\\n### 7. Interactive Features\\\\n\\\\n**Split Panels**:\\\\n- Resizable panels using Split.js\\\\n- Horizontal split: left/right (25/75 default)\\\\n- Vertical split: top/bottom (65/35 default)\\\\n- Custom gutter styling\\\\n\\\\n**Maps**:\\\\n- Leaflet.js integration\\\\n- Custom marker icons (CSS-based div icons)\\\\n- Smooth marker interpolation for drone movement\\\\n- Trail visualization with polylines\\\\n- Click-to-select waypoints\\\\n\\\\n**Real-time Updates**:\\\\n- WebSocket via Socket.IO\\\\n- Live telemetry updates\\\\n- Terminal output streaming\\\\n- Position updates with smooth interpolation\\\\n\\\\n### 8. Static Assets\\\\n\\\\nNo local image assets found. Uses:\\\\n- Emoji icons (✈, 🗺️, 🚁, etc.)\\\\n- CSS-based icons (arrows, dots, badges)\\\\n- Google Fonts (loaded via CDN)\\\\n- Leaflet map tiles (OpenStreetMap)\\\\n\\\\n### 9. Design Patterns\\\\n\\\\n**Component patterns**:\\\\n- Accordion sections (collapsible)\\\\n- Tab navigation (waypoint/batch tabs)\\\\n- Card-based layouts (drone cards)\\\\n- Badge system (status indicators)\\\\n\\\\n**State management**:\\\\n- Global state objects (&#96;appState&#96;, &#96;state&#96;)\\\\n- Event-driven updates via Socket.IO\\\\n- DOM manipulation for rendering\\\\n\\\\n**Animation**:\\\\n- CSS transitions (0.2s–0.3s)\\\\n- Keyframe animations (pulse, spin, slideIn)\\\\n- Smooth scrolling\\\\n- Hover effects\\\\n\\\\n### 10. Theme &amp; Color Scheme\\\\n\\\\nDark theme with:\\\\n- High contrast text (&#96;#e2e8f0&#96; on dark backgrounds)\\\\n- Muted secondary text (&#96;#94a3b8&#96;, &#96;#64748b&#96;)\\\\n- Color-coded status:\\\\n  - Green: running/active/success\\\\n  - Red: stopped/error/danger\\\\n  - Blue: primary actions/info\\\\n  - Orange: warnings/highlights\\\\n  - Purple: special features\\\\n\\\\n### 11. Accessibility Considerations\\\\n\\\\n- ARIA labels on hamburger button\\\\n- Semantic HTML (header, main, aside, nav)\\\\n- Keyboard navigation support\\\\n- Focus states on interactive elements\\\\n- Color contrast for readability\\\\n\\\\n### 12. Performance Optimizations\\\\n\\\\n- CSS custom properties for efficient theming\\\\n- RequestAnimationFrame for smooth animations\\\\n- Efficient DOM updates (selective rendering)\\\\n- Debounced updates for frequent events\\\\n- Lazy loading considerations for map tiles\\\\n\\\\n### Summary\\\\n\\\\nVanilla JavaScript web application with a dark theme. Uses CSS variables, glassmorphism, and smooth animations. Responsive with mobile support, real-time updates via WebSockets, and interactive maps. No build tools or CSS preprocessors; relies on CDN libraries and modern CSS The SITL binary (arducopter) typically opens a TCP server. I need to check what address it binds to. If it's 127.0.0.1, we have a problem - we need something to listen on 0.0.0.0 for the phone to connect. So we might need a TCP relay on the host that listens on 0.0.0.0:5760 and forwards to 127.0.0.1:5760. Or we need the container to listen on 0.0.0.0. Let me check ArduPilot SITL source - the TCP port might be bound to 0.0.0.0 by default for the simulator. I'll assume it listens on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) inside the container; Docker port mapping will then forward from host to container. So when phone connects to PC_IP:5760, the packet goes to Windows host port 5760, Docker forwards to container port 5760. The container's arducopter is listening on 5760. The question is - does arducopter bind to 0.0.0.0 or 127.0.0.1? In many SITL docs it says \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"connect to 127.0.0.1:5760\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" for local connection, w [... omitted end of long line]\\\\\\\"},{\\\\\\\"lineNumber\\\\\\\":2796,\\\\\\\"content\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"                  \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"content\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"The wrapper file - on Windows it's created with .py extension and content #!/bin/sh. When this is mounted in Linux Docker, the file might have Windows line endings (CRLF). Let me change the wrapper to have Unix line ending in the write. Also the script needs to be executable - we do chmod in the command. The volume mount ./mavproxy_wrapper - the path is relative to where docker-compose is run (the project dir). So when the user runs from d:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ardupilot, the mount is d:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ardupilot\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\mavproxy_wrapper -&amp;gt; /mavproxy_wrapper. Good. One more thing: the radarku image might have \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"mavproxy\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" as the module name (lowercase). We tried MAVProxy and it didn't work. So the wrapper uses \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"python3 -m mavproxy\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\". If that also fails, we could try \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"python3 -c \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"import mavproxy; mavproxy.main()\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" or similar. Database Configuration and Models\\\\n- No traditional database\\\\n- File-based persistence:\\\\n  - &#96;saved_locations.json&#96; — saved GPS locations\\\\n  - &#96;scenarios.json&#96; — saved drone scenarios/configurations\\\\n- In-memory state:\\\\n  - &#96;drones&#96; dictionary — active drone instances\\\\n  - &#96;container_state&#96; dictionary — Docker container status\\\\n- Thread-safe access via &#96;threading.Lock()&#96; (&#96;drone_lock&#96;)\\\\n\\\\n### 3. API Routes and Endpoints\\\\n\\\\n#### Container Management:\\\\n- &#96;GET /api/container/status&#96; — container status\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/container/start&#96; — start Docker container\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/container/stop&#96; — stop Docker container\\\\n\\\\n#### Drone Management:\\\\n- &#96;GET /api/drones&#96; — list all drones with telemetry\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/drone/start&#96; — start a drone instance\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/drone/&lt;drone_id&gt;/stop&#96; — stop specific drone\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/drone/&lt;drone_id&gt;/remove&#96; — remove drone from registry\\\\n- &#96;DELETE /api/drones/all&#96; — stop and remove all drones\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/drone/send&#96; — send command to drone\\\\n\\\\n#### Locations API:\\\\n- &#96;GET /api/locations&#96; — get saved locations\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/locations&#96; — save new location\\\\n- &#96;DELETE /api/locations/&lt;int:index&gt;&#96; — delete location by index\\\\n\\\\n#### Scenarios API:\\\\n- &#96;GET /api/scenarios&#96; — get all saved scenarios\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/scenarios&#96; — save current state as scenario\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/scenarios/duplicate&#96; — duplicate existing scenario\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/scenarios/rename&#96; — rename scenario\\\\n- &#96;DELETE /api/scenarios/&lt;path:name&gt;&#96; — delete scenario\\\\n- &#96;POST /api/scenarios/load&#96; — load and start scenario\\\\n\\\\n#### WebSocket Events (SocketIO):\\\\n- &#96;connect&#96; / &#96;disconnect&#96; — connection management\\\\n- &#96;request_drone_output&#96; — request terminal output\\\\n- &#96;drone_command&#96; — send command to drone\\\\n- Emitted events:\\\\n  - &#96;drone_output&#96; — terminal/log output\\\\n  - &#96;drone_position_update&#96; — GPS position updates\\\\n  - &#96;drone_telemetry_update&#96; — telemetry data\\\\n  - &#96;drone_status_update&#96; — status changes\\\\n  - &#96;container_status&#96; — container stats (CPU, memory)\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Data Processing Logic\\\\n\\\\n#### Telemetry Parsing (&#96;_parse_line_telemetry&#96;):\\\\nParses MAVProxy output for:\\\\n- Flight modes (GUIDED, LOITER, RTL, etc.)\\\\n- GPS position (&#96;GLOBAL_POSITION_INT&#96;)\\\\n- VFR HUD (speed, heading, altitude, climb rate)\\\\n- Battery status (&#96;SYS_STATUS&#96;)\\\\n- GPS fix info (&#96;GPS_RAW_INT&#96;)\\\\n- Arming status (&#96;HEARTBEAT&#96;, &#96;COMMAND_ACK&#96;)\\\\n\\\\n#### Process Management:\\\\n- &#96;_start_drone_process()&#96; — launches ArduPilot SITL via Docker exec\\\\n- &#96;stream_drone_output()&#96; — streams stdout with parsing\\\\n- &#96;stream_drone_stderr()&#96; — streams stderr\\\\n- &#96;periodic_telemetry()&#96; — sends periodic status commands\\\\n- &#96;_stop_drone()&#96; — graceful shutdown with SIGTERM/SIGKILL fallback\\\\n\\\\n#### Background Monitoring:\\\\n- &#96;_background_monitor()&#96; — container status polling (every 2 seconds)\\\\n- &#96;check_container_status()&#96; — Docker inspect for running state and stats\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Now I have a very thorough understanding of the project. Let me create a comprehensive plan with recommendations. The project is an ArduPilot SITL Manager - a web-based tool for managing ArduPilot SITL simulations in Docker containers.

Let me organize my recommendations into categories:

### Architecture / Code Quality
1. **Modüler Yapı**: app.py 1028 satır, monolitik. Backend'i Blueprint'lere bölmek iyi olur (container routes, drone routes, scenario routes, location routes).
2. **Frontend Modülerleştirme**: app.js 1430 satır, map.js 632 satır. Bunları modüllere bölmek lazım.


3. **Logging ve Error Handling**: print() yerine Python logging modülü kullanılmalı, type hints eklenebilir, ve `except Exception: pass` gibi generic exception handling'ler daha spesifik hale getirilmeli.

### Yeni Özellikler
1. **Uçuş Geçmişi / Log Kaydı**: Drone uçuşlarının loglarını kaydetme ve replay yapabilme.
2. **Çoklu Harita Katmanı**: Satellite view gibi ek görünüm seçenekleri.
3. **Drone Formasyonu**: Birden fazla drone'u V şekli, çizgi veya daire gibi formasyon düzenlerinde uçurma.
4. **Geofence**: Haritada sınır çizme ve drone'ların bu sınırları aşmasını engelleme.
5. **Otomatik Görev Planlama**: Waypoint mission'ları oluşturma ve kaydetme.
6. **Dashboard İstatistikleri**: Toplam uçuş süresi, mesafe ve ortalama hız gibi metrikleri gösterme.
7. **Bildirim Sistemi**: Düşük batarya veya bağlantı kopması gibi kritik olaylar için sesli ve görsel uyarılar.
8. **Klavye Kısayolları**: Hızlı kontroller için tuş kombinasyonları, dışa/içe aktarma özellikleri ve pymavlink ile doğrudan MAVLink bağlantısı kurma.

Tasarım tarafında, drone kartlarını daha bilgi yoğun hale getirmek, 3D görselleştirme eklemek, light/dark tema desteği sağlamak ve drone ikonlarını iyileştirmek istiyorum.

Telemetri verilerini grafiklerde göstermek, durum göstergelerini zenginleştirmek, yükleme durumlarını daha iyi göstermek, sürükle-bırak işlevselliği eklemek ve dashboard'a mini harita widget'ı koymak gerekiyor. Tablet görünümü de daha iyi optimize edilebilir.

Performans tarafında WebSocket bağlantısını throttle/debounce ile optimize etmek, büyük drone listeleri için virtual DOM kullanmak ve Redis veya SQLite ile durum kalıcılığını sağlamak önemli. DevOps için Dockerfile ve Docker Compose hazırlamak, ayrıca frontend geliştirme sırasında hot reload'u etkinleştirmek gerekiyor.</details></think>

Tasarim Iyilestirmeleri (UI/UX)\n\n### 3.1 SVG Drone Ikonlari\n- Emoji yerine ozel SVG ikonlar kullanilmali (haritada ve listede)\n- Heading'e gore donen drone ikonu (suan donen marker yok)\n- ARM/DISARM durumuna gore renk degisimi (yesil/kirmizi)\n- Arac tipine gore farkli ikon (copter/plane/rover)\n\n### 3.2 Mini Dashboard Widgetlari\n- Drone kartlarinda mini \"gauge\" gostergeler:\n  - Pusula (heading) - CSS ile donel ok\n  - Hiz gostergesi - dairesel progress\n  - Batarya gostergesi - renkli bar\n  - Irtifa gostergesi\n\n### 3.3 Dashboard Sayfasinda Mini Harita\n- Ana sayfa (index.html) icerisinde sidebar'da veya kontrol panelinde kucuk bir Leaflet haritasi\n- Tum drone'larin konumlarini gostermek icin (tam harita acmaya gerek kalmadan)\n\n### 3.4 Harita Katman Secenekleri\n- OpenStreetMap disinda ek tile provider'lar:\n  - Uydu goruntusu (Esri World Imagery - ucretsiz)\n  - Topografik harita\n  - Karanlik tema harita (CartoDB Dark Matter)\n- Katman gecis butonu harita uzerinde\n\n### 3.5 Loading State ve Skeleton UI\n- Container/drone baslatirken loading spinner + progress mesajlari\n- Sayfa yuklenirken skeleton placeholder\n- Button'larda loading durumu (disabled + spinner)\n\n### 3.6 Drag and Drop\n- Waypoint listesini surukle-birak ile siralama\n- Drone listesini surukle-birak ile siralama\n- Senaryolari surukle-birak ile gruplama\n\n### 3.7 Toast Bildirim Iyilestirme\n- Mevcut toast sistemi basit. Iyilestirmeler:\n  - Progress toast (uzun islemler icin)\n  - Dismissable (kapatilabilir)\n  - Stacking (ust uste biriken)\n  - Aksiyon butonu olan toast (\"Geri Al\" gibi)\n\n### 3.8 Terminal Iyilestirmeleri\n- xterm.js ile gercek terminal emulasyonu (renkli output, scroll performansi)\n- Terminal icerisinde arama (Ctrl+F)\n- Terminal ciktisini dosyaya kaydetme\n- Font boyutu ayarlanabilir\n\n### 3.9 Responsive Tablet Gorunumu\n- Mevcut responsive destek var ama tablet icin optimize edilebilir:\n  - iPad yatay modda iki panel yan yana\n  - Touch gesture destegi (pinch-zoom haritada, swipe panellerde)\n\n---\n\n## 4. Performans Iyilestirmeleri\n\n### 4.1 WebSocket Throttling\n- Telemetri emitleri cok sik olabilir. Backend'de throttle/debounce:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\n# Drone basina saniyede max 5 pozisyon update'i\nif now - last_emit[drone_id] &gt; 0.2:\n    socketio.emit('drone_position_update', data)\n    last_emit[drone_id] = now\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4.2 Frontend DOM Batch Update\n- Coklu drone durumunda her telemetri mesajinda DOM guncellemesi pahali\n- &#96;requestAnimationFrame&#96; ile batch update yapilmali\n- Gorunmeyen (scroll disinda) drone kartlarini guncellememe\n\n### 4.3 SQLite ile Kalici Durum\n- JSON dosyalari yerine SQLite kullanmak:\n  - Daha guvenilir yazma (atomic writes)\n  - Telemetri gecmisi icin sorgulama\n  - Buyuk veri setlerinde performans\n\n---\n\n## 5. Gelistirici Deneyimi (DX)\n\n### 5.1 Proje Yapilandirmasi\n- &#96;config.py&#96; dosyasi olusturularak tum yapilandirma tek yerden yonetilmeli:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nclass Config:\n    SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY', 'dev-secret')\n    DOCKER_IMAGE = 'ardupilot-sitl:final'\n    DEFAULT_PORTS = [...]\n    TELEMETRY_INTERVAL = 2\n    DB_PATH = 'data/app.db'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5.2 Docker Compose\n- Projeyi tek komutla ayaga kaldirmak icin &#96;docker-compose.yml&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\nservices:\n  web:\n    build: .\n    ports: [\"5000:5000\"]\n    volumes: [\"./data:/app/data\"]\n  sitl:\n    image: ardupilot-sitl:final\n    ports: [\"5770:5760\", \"14551:14550/udp\"]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5.3 Hot Reload\n- Frontend degisiklikleri icin Flask debug mode zaten acik\n- livereload veya browsersync entegrasyonu eklenebilir\n\n---\n\n## 6. Oncelik Sirasi (Onerilen)\n\nAsagidaki siralama, en cok katma deger saglayacak iyilestirmelerden baslayarak:\n\n**Yuksek Oncelik:**\n1. pymavlink entegrasyonu (telemetri guvenirligi)\n2. Telemetri grafikleri (kullanilabilirlik)\n3. SVG drone ikonlari + heading rotasyonu (gorsellik)\n4. Mini harita dashboard'da (pratiklik)\n5. Backend modulerlestirme (surdurulebilirlik)\n\n**Orta Oncelik:**\n6. Ucus gecmisi / log kaydi\n7. Harita katman secenekleri\n8. Geofence\n9. Klavye kisayollari\n10. Loading states\n\n**Dusuk Oncelik (ama guzel olur):**\n11. Drone formasyonu\n12. xterm.js terminal\n13. Mission planner iyilestirme\n14. Docker Compose\n15. Export/Import\n",
